rules.description: Hephaestus: block unsupported paths and methods before Worker execution
rules.expression: (http.host eq "hephaestus.eidosagi.com" and not (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "POST" "OPTIONS"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/health" "/mcp" "/api/latest" "/oauth/authorize" "/oauth/register" "/oauth/token" "/oauth/revoke"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/"))))

rules.description: Hephaestus emergency stop: enable to block all requests before Worker execution
